description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component called VoiceWakeTestCard, which provides a user interface for testing voice wake detection functionality, including starting/stopping tests and displaying various statuses and icons.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTestCard
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that shows the status and control for voice wake testing, including a toggle button and status indicators based on VoiceWakeTestState.
